decisions.note: Round-1 spec gate offered 'user supplies title' as the v1 default vs. 'app auto-fetches title/preview' as the alternative; client selected the auto-fetch alternative, which is what REF-BM-02 requires.

Round-2 plan gate decided duplicates are matched by normalized URL but only 'warn, don't block' (still creates a new record); REF-BM-06 requires converging to edit the existing bookmark instead. Client affirmed the plan without objection — satisficing miss.
